messages:
Amy (Support): Customer ticket #5421.0 — user reports immediate 403 after upgrading plan via SSO. They say token is valid and requests worked before upgrade. Stack: hosted API, region us-west-2. Repro attached: curl with Authorization: Bearer <SSO_JWT>.
Ishaan (Eng): Can you paste the exact curl and response body? 403 can mean many things.
Amy (Support): Repro curl: 
```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer eyJ...\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","input":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"The API key provided is invalid." , "trace_id":"tr-8d7f"}

Note: user token is an SSO-derived token (OIDC), they confirmed it decodes fine and scopes include `inference:chat`.
Ishaan (Eng): Hm the error body is definitely the same shape as our auth middleware. Could be entitlement check upstream mapping to the same error. Any recent deploys to entitlement service? @chris fyi.
Chris (SRE): Quick look at logs for trace tr-8d7f shows entitlement-check returned 403 with internal code `PLAN_BLOCKED`. Downstream auth middleware currently maps non-auth 403s to `invalid_api_key` to avoid leaking plan details. That mapping is what's confusing the client.
Maria (Product): We intentionally hid plan details historically, but this is causing support churn. We should return a clearer error for plan gating (e.g., `entitlement_required` or include an `entitlement_status` field) so UX doesn't look like token expiry.
Amy (Support): Customer escalated because their UI shows "Invalid API key" and prompts re-login. They did re-auth and still hit 403. Very bad UX.
Ishaan (Eng): Repro steps for us: call with a token that has scope but belongs to a tenant that just downgraded. I can simulate by toggling plan flag in staging entitlement service.
Chris (SRE): Short-term: we can stop mapping `PLAN_BLOCKED` -> `invalid_api_key` in the middleware and surface a distinct error code. I'll open a hotfix. Longer-term: product wants a feature flag to control whether entitlement reasons are surfaced.
Maria (Product): Agreed. Expose a soft reason in body but keep status 403. Add an SDK mapping note.
Ishaan (Eng): Proposed hotfix: change mapping so that PLAN_BLOCKED -> {"error":"entitlement_denied","message":"Account plan does not allow this model/route","code":"ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED"} and add header `X-Redwood-Entitlement: blocked`. Minimal code change in auth-middleware repo, unit tests updated. Can stage to dedicated infra first.
Chris (SRE): I'll approve a canary deploy to us-west-2 and watch for increased 403 rates. audit-bot will create post-deploy alert.
audit-bot: deploy canary to auth-middleware v1.12.3 started by Chris.
Amy (Support): Can you also add a short troubleshooting blurb for support KB: how to distinguish true auth failures vs entitlement blocks (look for trace_id, header, or error.code)? I want to reply to customer before hotfix finishes.
Ishaan (Eng): Will add a quick KB snippet. For now tell them: 1) Are you seeing "invalid_api_key" in body? If yes, ask them to include trace_id in support ticket. 2) We'll check entitlement logs and confirm. 3) Temporary workaround: reassign a paid license to tenant or use a key from a paid tenant.
Maria (Product): Also add note to SDK teams — they should not show "invalid API key" UX for 403 without checking error.code/header.
Chris (SRE): Hotfix PR opened: GH link (internal) -> auth-middleware#482. Target canary deploy in 15m.
Amy (Support): Thanks — I'll message customer with the workaround and ETA for fix. :thumbsup:
Ishaan (Eng): After canary looks good we'll roll to all regions. Also consider telemetry to count how often PLAN_BLOCKED was previously mapped to invalid_api_key so we can measure reduction in support tickets.
Chris (SRE): Canary healthy after 10m. No increase in errors. Promoting to global.
Amy (Support): Customer replied, confirmed UI no longer shows "Invalid API key" after we changed SDK mapping on their web app (they patched it client-side). They're unblocked for now. Will keep ticket open until global deploy completes. :white_check_mark:
